title: SYNTHETIC — P-A trade credit policy
text: SYNTHETIC fixture; not a real transaction. These are synthetic terms. Sending a notice does not establish coverage or claim eligibility.

fields.clause.applicability: This synthetic policy applies to listed buyers and invoices within its stated period.
fields.clause.mep: The maximum extension period ends 60 days after the invoice due date.
fields.clause.notice: Notice must be made within 30 days after the maximum extension period ends.
fields.clause.waiting_period: The claim window opens 60 days after the notice receipt.
fields.clause.claim_documents: The package requires an invoice, signed POD, contract and statement of account.
fields.clause.collection_history: A follow-up receipt or readable collection note is required.
fields.clause.credit_limit: A balance above the stated credit limit is restricted in the checklist.
fields.clause.disputed_debt: Disputed debt is excluded until resolved.
fields.clause.stop_shipment: Stop further shipments after the maximum extension period ends.
